name: B10-0518/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Le cas de Paata Burchuladze et des prisonniers politiques sous le régime du parti Rêve géorgien
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Paata Burchuladze and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream Regime
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It calls for the release of Georgian opera singer Paata Burchuladze, jailed for seven years after a protest, saying his trial was unfair. It asks the European Union and its member states to impose sanctions on Georgia's ruling party leader Bidzina Ivanishvili and other officials, and names five people it wants sanctioned for human rights abuses.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament only asks the EU and member states to act.
- **Who it affects:** Georgia's leaders, including Ivanishvili, and five named officials.
- **What happens next:** The Council and member states decide whether to impose sanctions.
